title: IS machine high vibration
summary: Repeated vibration on forming section linked to dry bearing and poor lubrication
action_taken: Replaced bearing and cleaned lubrication line

title: Packaging suction issue
summary: Intermittent bottle pickup failures caused by worn suction cups and vacuum leakage
action_taken: Replaced suction cups and checked vacuum hose

title: Conveyor belt drift
summary: Belt tracking drift caused accumulation and current spikes

title: Furnace overheating
summary: Burner zone temperature drifted upward and flow dropped below target
action_taken: Inspected burner and cleaned flow restriction

title: Feeder low pressure
summary: Low pneumatic pressure caused unstable gob delivery
action_taken: Replaced leaking valve and checked filter
